io.name: rst
io.notes: active-high reset; assumed synchronous because no asynchronous reset edge is specified

io.name: dcsb_dat_o
io.notes: BIU return data forwarded to DC side

io.name: dcsb_ack_o
io.notes: local one-cycle store acceptance acknowledgment or direct BIU acknowledgment

io.name: dcsb_err_o
io.notes: forced low for buffered-store path; direct BIU error otherwise

io.name: sbbiu_dat_o
io.notes: BIU-side write data or direct DC-side data

io.name: sbbiu_we_o
io.notes: forced high for buffered-store path; direct DC-side write qualifier otherwise

io.name: sbbiu_cab_o
io.notes: forced low for buffered-store path; direct DC-side burst indication otherwise

reset.name: rst
reset.assumption: Reset is sampled on the rising clock edge.

dcsb_ack_o.notes: For an accepted buffered write, fifo_wr occurs at the capture edge and the registered local acknowledgment is asserted on the following clock cycle. On the direct path, dcsb_ack_o is a combinational forwarding of sbbiu_ack_i and has zero interface latency.

functional_summary: When OR1200_SB_IMPLEMENTED is enabled, buffer only valid DC-side writes satisfying dcsb_cyc_i && dcsb_stb_i && dcsb_we_i, provided the FIFO is not full and the previous local write acknowledgment is not being held.
Store the buffered payload as {dcsb_sel_i, dcsb_dat_i, dcsb_adr_i}; do not store we, cab, cyc, or stb.
Select the Store Buffer BIU path when sel_sb = !fifo_empty || (!fifo_empty && outstanding_store) equivalently !fifo_empty || outstanding_store; otherwise select the direct DC-to-BIU path.
The buffered path drives the FIFO payload to the BIU, forces sbbiu_we_o high, and forces sbbiu_cab_o low. It occupies and prioritizes the BIU interface over new direct requests.

Only one buffered store may be outstanding on the BIU side. fifo_rd is asserted whenever outstanding_store is low, allowing the FIFO implementation to fetch a request; the FIFO itself determines whether an empty read actually pops an entry.
outstanding_store is cleared by sbbiu_ack_i; otherwise it is set when the Store Buffer path is selected or a new store is written into the FIFO.

For the Store Buffer path, dcsb_ack_o is fifo_wr_ack and dcsb_err_o is forced low. For the direct path, dcsb_ack_o and dcsb_err_o forward sbbiu_ack_i and sbbiu_err_i, respectively. dcsb_dat_o always forwards sbbiu_dat_i.
When OR1200_SB_IMPLEMENTED is disabled, all DC-side request signals pass directly to the corresponding BIU outputs and BIU data, acknowledgment, and error signals pass directly back to the DC side.
corner_cases: Reset clears outstanding_store and fifo_wr_ack; the FIFO must be reset to empty. No buffered transaction may be considered outstanding after reset.
A valid write is not locally acknowledged when the FIFO is full or fifo_wr_ack is already asserted.
The local buffered-write acknowledgment indicates FIFO acceptance only, not BIU completion, and BIU errors for buffered stores are intentionally not returned to the DC side.
A pending FIFO entry or outstanding store blocks direct read and non-buffered requests from reaching the BIU until the Store Buffer path is released.

When sbbiu_ack_i is asserted for an outstanding buffered store, that store completes and outstanding_store is cleared on the active clock edge; no new buffered store may be treated as simultaneously completed unless the specified state-update priority is preserved.
FIFO capacity and pointer-width behavior are delegated to the internal or1200_sb_fifo implementation because the specification does not define its depth.
The non-implemented configuration must not depend on FIFO state, outstanding_store, or fifo_wr_ack and must remain a pure combinational pass-through.
test_plan: Compile and test both configurations: with OR1200_SB_IMPLEMENTED defined and undefined.
Apply reset with all ordinary request and response inputs idle, then verify cleared local state behavior and an empty Store Buffer.
Issue an accepted buffered write and verify payload storage, one-cycle-delayed local dcsb_ack_o, forced-low buffered dcsb_err_o, and no requirement to wait for BIU acknowledgment.
Hold sbbiu_ack_i low while issuing multiple stores and verify FIFO ordering, BIU serialization, and that only one buffered store is active at a time.
Acknowledge each buffered BIU transaction and verify outstanding_store release and transition back to direct-path operation.
Fill the FIFO to capacity and verify that an additional valid write is not accepted or locally acknowledged until space is available.
Issue reads and non-buffered requests while the FIFO is non-empty or a buffered store is outstanding; verify they are blocked from the BIU, then pass through after Store Buffer release.
Verify buffered BIU transactions force sbbiu_we_o=1 and sbbiu_cab_o=0 while preserving address, data, and byte select.
Verify direct-path requests preserve all DC-side request controls and directly forward BIU ack, error, and return data.
Test simultaneous FIFO activity and BIU acknowledgment, reset during pending activity, and consecutive back-to-back accepted writes.

verifier: Drive all inputs to idle values before releasing reset; ordinary active-high request and response inputs idle at zero.

Sample registered state-dependent outputs after the rising edge, preferably at the following falling edge to avoid race conditions; sample combinational direct-path behavior after input changes settle.
Model buffered-store acknowledgment separately from BIU completion: an accepted FIFO write is acknowledged one clock later, while its BIU transaction may complete much later.
Use the actual FIFO capacity from the compiled or1200_sb_fifo implementation when testing full and empty behavior.
Check that direct requests are never forwarded while sel_sb is asserted, and check exact payload/control transformations on the buffered BIU path.
coder: Preserve the exact module name, port names, directions, and widths; OR1200_SB_IMPLEMENTED is a compile-time configuration, not a module parameter.
Implement reset synchronously on posedge clk unless the surrounding source explicitly supplies a different reset convention.
Use explicit 68-bit FIFO packing and unpacking: {sel[3:0], dat[31:0], adr[31:0]}.
Keep FIFO read enable, FIFO empty handling, sel_sb, outstanding_store, and fifo_wr_ack semantics distinct; fifo_rd itself is !outstanding_store and need not include !fifo_empty.
Ensure buffered BIU controls force write semantics and non-consecutive addressing, while the undefined configuration is a pure direct pass-through.
debugger: First check reset polarity and synchronous versus asynchronous implementation, then inspect FIFO empty/full and pointer timing.
Check off-by-one errors in fifo_wr_ack and local dcsb_ack_o timing.
Check outstanding_store update priority when sbbiu_ack_i, sel_sb, and fifo_wr occur in the same cycle.
Check that reads are not accidentally buffered or allowed through while a buffered store owns the BIU.
Check payload bit ordering, forced sbbiu_we_o/sbbiu_cab_o values, and masking of buffered-store errors.
Check that the non-implemented preprocessor branch has no references to unavailable FIFO or state signals.
